title: Record Type Classification
story: As the AI Assistant, I want to determine whether a request is an Incident or Service Request, so that the correct ticket type is created.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the user describes a failure or outage
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is classified as an Incident

acceptanceCriteria.given: the user requests access, equipment, or new services
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is classified as a Service Request

acceptanceCriteria.given: the user describes an ambiguous request
acceptanceCriteria.when: the assistant cannot determine the type

acceptanceCriteria.given: the assistant proposes a ticket type
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user can review and correct the proposed ticket type before submission

edgeCases: Request that could be both incident and service request
User explicitly states the wrong ticket type
Description changes from incident to service request mid-conversation
Multiple issues described in a single message (one incident, one SR)
